L480: ### What Mock Adapter DOES NOT Do
L481: 
L482: - ❌ **Persist data** - All data is in-memory, lost on restart
L483: - ❌ **Real API calls** - No external network requests
L484: - ❌ **Real authentication** - Simplified security model
L485: - ❌ **Rate limiting** - No request throttling
L486: - ❌ **Real ad serving** - No actual ads delivered
L487: - ❌ **Cross-principal queries** - Strict isolation
L488: ### When to Use Real Adapters
L489: 
L490: Use GAM/Kevel/Triton adapters for:
L491: - Integration testing with real ad servers
L492: - Staging environment validation
L493: - Production deployments
L494: - Testing adapter-specific features
L495: - Performance testing with real APIs
